notes.HESITATION_1_term_loan_commitment_vs_spi: The Initial Term Loan class is larger than the Initial Term Commitment. Section 1.13 and the definition of "Initial Term Loans" ("means (a) the term loans made by the Initial Term Lenders to the Company pursuant to Section 2.01(a) and (b) the SpinCo Term Loans") roll US$1,130,000,000 of SpinCo Term Loans, funded under a separate Term Credit Agreement of the same date, into this class at the Merger effective time, so US$3,750,000,000 of Initial Term Loans are outstanding on the Closing Date. Labeled 2,620,000,000 because (i) the field is the commitment and the defined term "Initial Term Commitment" states that figure, (ii) the SpinCo loans are not commitments under this agreement — 1.13(c)(i) says they "shall not be required to be funded in accordance with Section 2.06" — and were extended under an instrument outside this document, and (iii) the combined US$3,750,000,000 figure never appears in the document, so it cannot carry a verbatim citation. Proposed rule for schema.md: aggregate_commitment records the defined-term commitment made under the agreement; loans converted or assumed from another instrument at closing are noted here, not added. A reviewer keying off the economic tranche size would expect 3.75B.
notes.HESITATION_2_step_down_effective_from_ha: step_down_schedule.effective_from is typed as a date, but the 6.09 table states only a fiscal-period formula and "Fiscal Year" is defined as "the fiscal year of the Company" with no date. The document elsewhere references "the Fiscal Year ending on or about October 3, 2025" (Section 2.10), i.e. a 52/53-week calendar — the case schema.md says not to resolve. Recorded the agreement's own formulation as the value. Diagnostic only, not labeled: the fourth full Fiscal Quarter after the Closing Date is Q4 FY2025 (ending on or about 2025-10-03), so the first Test Period at 5.00x is the one ending Q1 FY2026 (on or about early January 2026). Proposed rule: where no calendar date is stated, effective_from is the verbatim period formulation, scored as a normalized string, mirroring maturity_date basis=relative.
notes.HESITATION_3_term_loan_has_margin_grid: The Initial Term Loan margin is a flat 2.25% with no table, but carries a one-time, one-way 0.25% step-down triggered by an external ratings event (Ba3 / BB- / BB- from all three agencies). Labeled true under the explicit rule that "a single step-down on a one-time event ... is true" and that the field draws fixed-vs-variable, not table-vs-no-table. Flagging because in market usage this is not called a grid, and a relabel might reach false if that rule were ever loosened.
notes.facility_name_choice: Section 2.01 does not put tranche names in quotes. Term tranche labeled "Initial Term Loans" (2.01(a), cover page, and the defined-loan-term convention of the worked example). Revolver labeled "Initial Revolving Facility" (defined facility term; recitals). Alternatives the borrower also uses: "Initial Term Facility", "Initial Revolving Loans", "Revolving Facility" (cover page and 6.09).
notes.maturity_diagnostics: Closing Date is defined as September 27, 2024. Computed, not labeled: term loan 2031-09-27 is a Saturday, so the Business Day proviso would push it to 2031-09-29; revolver 2029-09-27 is a Thursday. basis=relative because the agreement states a formula, not a hard date. No springing-maturity proviso in either Maturity Date definition ("Inside Maturity Amount" governs incremental debt only).
notes.revolver_margin: Opening level is explicitly Category 2 until the first Adjustment Date following completion of at least one full Fiscal Quarter after the Closing Date — stated, not deferred, so an integer not null. Category 2 Term Benchmark/RFR Spread = 2.00%. Full grid (Term Benchmark/RFR): Cat 1 >3.75x 2.25%; Cat 2 <=3.75x >2.75x 2.00%; Cat 3 <=2.75x >1.75x 1.75%; Cat 4 <=1.75x 1.50%. ABR spreads are 100 bps lower in every row. Failure to deliver a Compliance Certificate reverts pricing to Category 1.
notes.commitment_fee_grid_not_a_margin_grid: A separate "Commitment Fee Rate" grid keyed to the same First Lien Leverage Ratio exists (Category 1 0.40%, Category 2 0.35%, opening Category 2). Not scored; noted per the Paya rule as a candidate for a v2 has_commitment_fee_grid field.
notes.benchmark_multicurrency: Revolver permits Alternative Currencies (Canadian Dollars, Euro, Sterling). 2.12(b) prices USD Term Benchmark Borrowings at Term SOFR, Euro at the EURIBO Rate, CAD at Term CORRA; Sterling is an RFR (Daily Simple SONIA) borrowing. Primary benchmark is USD Term SOFR. Daily Simple SOFR appears only as a 2.13 fallback. No credit spread adjustment issue — "Term SOFR" is unadjusted with a zero floor.
notes.covenant_notes: Single financial covenant; "Financial Covenant" is defined as "the covenant contained in Section 6.09". It runs "Solely with respect to the Revolving Facility" — standard cov-lite TLB structure; recorded per the rule, beneficiary noted here. Interest Coverage Ratio, Secured Leverage Ratio and Total Leverage Ratio are defined but used only as incurrence tests. First test date: Test Period ending on the last day of the second full Fiscal Quarter ending after the Closing Date. Test Period is four consecutive Fiscal Quarters, tested at each Fiscal Quarter end (quarterly, springing — springing is not a frequency).
notes.springing_trigger_exclusions: Utilization counts Revolving Loans, Swingline Loans and LC drawings unreimbursed for more than five Business Days; undrawn LCs do not count, and drawings under LCs that are 100% cash-collateralized or backstopped are excluded. Proviso: (a) Closing Date revolver borrowings used to fund the Transactions are excluded for the first and second full Fiscal Quarters after the Closing Date, then included; (b) Closing Date borrowings funding OID/fees are excluded permanently. None of this changes the 40% threshold.
notes.excluded_from_records: Letter of Credit Sublimit US$200,000,000 and the Swingline sublimit (2.04) are carve-outs of the revolver — no records. Section 2.21 Incremental Credit Extensions, Incremental Equivalent Debt, Replacement Term Loans / Replacement Revolving Facility, and Extended/Modified facilities are options or future classes — no records. Section 2.09(a)(i) first amortization payment is March 31, 2025.
notes.citation_method: Every quote was checked as a verbatim substring of the whitespace-normalized text extracted from the HTML exhibit; each quote matches exactly once except the revolver has_margin_grid quote, which matches four times (first occurrence is in the Applicable Rate definition). Quotes were kept within a single page span because the exhibit embeds page numbers (e.g. "82") mid-sentence at page breaks, which would break a longer verbatim match.
